property: for a state_dir that holds no peer-lane state (no entry named peer-* under it), no persisted-state write outside the peer lane changes between each first-parent commit in [measured_from, target] and target, so target reads all state the base wrote. status.json is outside this property: every run loop rewrites it whole. The run loop never reads it for routing or persisted-state decisions; `status` and the console render it, while `status --check` reads its liveness fields (interval_s, last_poll_ts). Target's readers accept a base's status.json without the members target adds

pre_registry.statement: An upgrade of the local router to the M1 pin (6d104e70) on a configuration that sets `registry_dir`, from a router whose state is keyed by instance name (any router that ran without `registry_dir`, including every commit before a84e0d986e96460a4c1ad0563675fbf32c6a104f, the first that can read `registry_dir`), is supported by the router's own migration and not by router-upgrade-bases.json's measured property. The router holds each such instance (`state_not_migrated`, then `legacy_state_unadopted`) until, with the router stopped, the operator moves the instance's state directory to its logical id and runs `generation adopt <name> --reason <text>`, adding `--no-transport-history=N` when the command asks for it. After adopt, the first-sight marker and the reply ledger carry over, and the instance drains. measured_from stays 6479a05c.
